callouts.1: Explicit spike encoders: standalone neurons spike the normed input of both sub-layers, the o-norm output and fc1's output (replacing GELU), so every weight sees binary spikes.
callouts.2: Conv spike taps: a neuron fires on each ShortConv input, but the conv keeps using the analog signal; the taps only add to the collected spike count.
callouts.3: Spiking decay feedback: the state-norm feedback net becomes SpikingLinear(1→8) → tanh → LIF → SpikingLinear(8→1).
callouts.4: Dual spiking decay gates: two more SpikingLinears (d → H) shift and rescale the decay logit, g̃ = (g + g_{mod})·2σ(g_{mult}), so input spikes control forgetting per head more freely.
